translation: Twenty-nine: After the ear healed, I still rubbed the jaw. A few days later, suddenly tinea broke out simultaneously on the yin side of the whole body, not like the previous time which was only on the flanks and ribs; the abdomen and hips were distended and itchy, and there was no way to deal with it. I used a large lump of alum, rubbing and scraping together, and fortunately it did not fester.
